g.aria-label: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Multi-Head Sequence Mixer Block
Why Query/Key L2 Normalization + RMSNorm Output Gate Are Essential
• Unit-norm k̂_t bounds each outer-product write ||v_t k̂_tᵀ||₂ = ||v_t||₂ without softmax normalization
• Per-head RMSNorm stabilizes accumulated S_t q̂_t scale before multiplying by the SiLU output gate
